description.zh: 指定要删除的API网关插件的ID
description.en: The ID of the plug-in to be deleted.

description.zh: 指定规则所适用的对象标签，可设置多个。
description.en: The tag of objects that match the rule. You can specify multiple tags.

description.zh:
标签键。

n 的取值范围为 `[1, 20]`
description.en:
The key of the tag.

N can be an integer from 1 to 20.\`\`

description.zh:
标签值。

n 的取值范围为 `[1, 20]`
description.en:
The value of the tag.

N can be an integer from 1 to 20.\`\`

descriptions.zh:
- 此接口面向开放API的用户。
- 必须先解除API和插件的绑定关系，否则删除报错。
descriptions.en:
- This operation is intended for API providers.

- You must first unbind the plug-in from the API. Otherwise, an error is reported when you delete the plug-in.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi delete-plugin --plugin-id 9a3f1a5279434f2ba74ccd91c295af9f --tag Value=example-string Key=env --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
